text:
No satellite thermal detection was found at this asset (ASSET-F08, rural property) between 4 Oct and 3 Nov 2026. NASA FIRMS returned zero detections intersecting the asset boundary. All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of that period, so the lack of detections isn't due to missing data.

This doesn't prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. The result also says nothing about:
- burned area, whether present or absent
- the cause of any change on the ground
- anything before or after the evaluated window

The evidence was current as of 12 Nov 2026. If you need firmer assurance, burned-area or imagery-based analysis would be the next step.
